verdict.rationale: Gmail's own Gemini integration documents organizing actions such as deleting multiple emails or adding labels on request (gmail-docs-14). Filters built from combinable search operators automatically add or remove labels or forward matching messages (gmail-docs-15, gmail-docs-38, gmail-docs-47, gmail-docs-48), and the API manages threads, messages and labels (gmail-docs-39). The bulk-action evidence itself is a single thin line, and filters only act on incoming mail. Missing for 10: a documented batch or bulk-modify API endpoint, retroactive bulk actions on existing mail via filters, scale limits for Gemini bulk actions, and hands-on corroboration.
